title: Fall 2026 Wood Firing Workshop At Adamah Clay Studio
summary: Wood fire your 60-80 bisque pots in Adamah Clay Studio's anagama kiln near Dodgeville (October 24-29, unload TBD). Work crew shifts stoking; between shifts, throw pots, hike, or visit galleries. Registration opens January 1, 2026.
commitment: October 24-29 load and fire; crew shifts required
evidence_sentence: The Windy Ridge workshops page lists a wood firing at Adamah's anagama kiln where participants take shifts stoking.
